data.description:
## What
Add two new config key entries to plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md under a new subsection 'preconditions.inference_review':

- preconditions.inference_review.rate_rationale: sampling rate for rationale-text-only inference decisions (accepts 0-100, default 20, no floor)
- preconditions.inference_review.rate_high_stakes: sampling rate for high-stakes decisions affecting gate_verdicts or workflow_completion_checklist (accepts integer, default 100, floor=100 enforced at config-load time — values below 100 rejected with non-zero exit)

Each entry should follow the standard table format used by other config keys:
| | |
|---|---|
| Description | ... |
| Accepted values | ... |
| Default | ... |
| Floor | ... (rate_high_stakes only) |
| Used by | ... |

Also document: absent keys default to 20 and 100 respectively, with a one-time install-time log entry stating the active default. The floor validator must be noted — skill refuses to start when rate_high_stakes < 100.

Satisfies: SC5 done definition, ec78-d60d.

## Files to update
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md — insert new subsection after existing preconditions.* section or after test_quality.* if no preconditions section exists yet
data.title: Add preconditions.inference_review config keys to CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
